text:
ash: APAC GPU pool spiking hard, queue length >8k and climbing. spillover policy kicked but we're seeing unexpected routing to EU and cost is blowing up. putting this thread to coordinate admission control + fallback.
kevin: seeing same, p95 token latency jumped from 120ms -> 540ms. autoscaler isn't catching up; pods stuck in Pending due to AZ imbalance.
maria: is this traffic sudden from a single customer or broad? any large model batch jobs ramping?
ash: looks broad; several tenants increasing traffic. Prom shows high KV cache misses after spillover — cold-kv penalty.
lucy: @ash can you post the routing rules that fired? want to check cross-region weight.
ash: here's the simplified config that triggered:
```
route: {
  priority: [prod, standard, best-effort],
  cross_region_spill: true,
  fallback_models: {gpt-large->gpt-medium-8bit}
}
```
kevin: cross_region_spill=true allowed traffic to EU with no hard cost cap. we should have budgeted failover lanes. also noticing sticky session headers not preserved, so KV cache warm isn't shared.
praveen: proposal: flip admission control to per-customer token limiter + global shed for best-effort. start by disabling cross-region spill for APAC for 10m and circuit-break customers over 2x baseline.
maria: agree. additionally, enable model-fallback earlier for tail latency-sensitive tenants. fallback threshold: queue_depth > 1000 or p95 > 250ms.
ash: doing a quick toggle now: disabling cross-region spill for apac by setting region_policy.override=local-first. will report effects in 1m.
sre-bot: incident created #INC-APAC-SPILL-1918234567, severity: high. Alerting on queue_growth and cooldown actions.
kevin: also make sure Dedicated customers (cust:enterprise-42) are exempt from automated fallback unless they opt in.
lucy: cost note — EU GPUs ~1.6x cost. spilling there increases burn. we should add a soft budget guard that refuses spillover when estimated 1h cost delta > $X.
praveen: pseudo-config for admission control:
```
admission:
  per_tenant_limit: true
  global_shed_order: [best-effort, standard]
  fallback_trigger: {queue_depth:1000, p95_ms:250}
  cross_region_budget_limit: 1.25 # multiplier
```
maria: Ash, any visible network error spikes? could be connectivity causing longer startup times.
ash: minor transient ENI errors 10:42-10:44 UTC but nothing huge. main issue is capacity fragmentation across AZs + lack of warm pools for medium models.
kevin: action list:
- ash: disable cross-region spill for APAC (in progress)
- praveen: patch admission control and add budget guard (10m)
- lucy: run cost estimate for spill scenarios and propose threshold (15m)
- maria: identify top offending tenants and message them (20m)
- kevin: prepare rollback for toggle (5m)
ash: disabled cross-region spill at 10:40:12 UTC. queue growth slowed but p95 still high. beginning emergency model-fallback rollout for standard tier.
maria: pinged top 3 tenants with abnormal traffic; two acknowledged and are throttling. one is a marketplace partner, asking for help to reduce spikes.
praveen: deployed admission control change to staging, will push to prod after quick smoke (3m)
kevin: note for postmortem: we should have automated warm-pool priming for fallback models on spillover trigger to avoid KV cold penalty. otherwise cost wins are negated by latency.
lucy: agreed. add to backlog: warm-pool orchestration + cross-region budget guard + per-tenant surge limits.
ash: thanks team — monitoring. will update when p95 < 300ms or queue < 500.
kevin: nice work. :thumbsup:
ash: update 10:47:20 UTC — p95 down to 280ms, queue ~620. continuing to observe.
praveen: prod rollout complete at 10:48:52 UTC. admission control active.
sre-bot: incident INC-APAC-SPILL-1918234567 status: mitigated, actions taken: disabled cross-region spill, enabled admission-control, initiated model-fallback. severity downgraded to medium.
ash: marking thread as resolved for now. will start follow-up doc and postmortem in #postmortems with timeline and cost impact.
kevin: capture cost delta for the hour and list of tenants affected. also include recommended SLA tweaks.
maria: I'll draft the tenant communication note.
lucy: pushing an RFC for spill budget guard next sprint.
praveen: adding a short runbook snippet to prod ops:
```
If APAC queue > 2000:
 - toggle cross_region_spill -> false
 - ramp fallback for standard tier
 - enable per-tenant cap 2x baseline
 - notify oncall & customers
```
ash: thanks all — closing. :white_check_mark:
